result:one module (milestone-stop, milestone M2): usage_draft.stop decides the first finished, unconfirmed milestone of a usage draft; the stage hint adds a milestone-stop line, replaces the suggested next step and attaches the node-rules section, keeping the stage line; new command milestone-mark records a confirmation line after the Milestones table (preview by default, --confirm to write); /map --json gains top-level milestoneStop and interface goes from 1.12 to 1.13 (addition only); verify-artifacts checks confirmation lines; a module in two milestones is reported once
